title: SMOK Baby V2 A1 Coils 0.17 Ohm
description: These high-quality, high-performance sub ohm coils are designed for use with the Smok Baby V2 tank and offer unrivalled vapour production and flavour payoff. The A1 has a large hole inside the coil which is covered in robust mesh to allow for faster, more evenly-distributed heating for a deliciously-satisfying vape every time.
